tree.heading: Eligible orchardist
tree.text: The term “eligible orchardist” means a person that produces annual crops from trees for commercial purposes.

tree.heading: Natural disaster
tree.text: The term “natural disaster” means plant disease, insect infestation, drought, fire, freeze, flood, earthquake, lightning, and other occurrence, as determined by the Secretary.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture.

tree.heading: Tree
tree.text: The term “tree” includes a tree, bush, and vine.
